Discovers all AUTOFIX-*.json under .zqk/autofix/ and processes each via the

standardized



pipeline (INGEST → NORMALIZE → COMMIT → FINALIZE) per

docs/architecture/data-pipeline-lifecycle.md.



Used by SCH-autofix-process-pending so autofix files don't build up; can be

triggered when



batches are submitted or run on a timer. Internal command (hidden from main

help).



Process pending (scheduler or manual)

zqk system auto-fix-process-pending

With explicit project root

zqk system auto-fix-process-pending --project-root /path/to/project

Usage:
  zqk system auto-fix-batch [flags]

Flags:
      --batch-file string                    Path to batch JSON file (required)
      --chunk-size int                       Number of issues per transactional chunk
      --columns string                       Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
  -f, --format string                        Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link, raw, md, html) (default "table")
      --ignore-scheduler-down[=true|false]   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
  -o, --output string                        Write output to file
      --project-root string                  Project root directory
  -q, --quiet[=true|false]                   Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration                     Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose[=true|false]                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded[=true|false]   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
